3856.title: Project skill discovery rejects internal aliases
3856.rootCauseOneLine: The flat skill scanner permits symlinks only for user-origin roots, ignoring the supplied project boundary.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed; containment proposal addresses the gate but was not executed.

3856.proposedFix: Design and test boundary-aware project symlink traversal; excluded from automatic simple fixes as a security-boundary change.
3856.caveats: Scanner reproduced twice; live provider counts and UI not verified.
